measurement: The thigh liner size matches the size of your Unloader One brace, XS to XL; order the same size as your current brace frame. If you are unsure of your brace size, measure calf circumference 6 in. below mid-patella with the leg extended and match to the Unloader One brace size chart. The liner attaches to the brace frame using hook and loop backing and is worn against the skin beneath the shell for cushioning and comfort during wear. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
